title: A Walk in the Woods
author: Bill Bryson
summary: Bill Bryson sets out to hike the Appalachian Trail with his out-of-shape friend Katz, mixing comic misadventures with the history and ecology of the trail.
readIf: you like humorous travel writing with nature and history tucked in.
skipIf: you want a serious, complete account of a thru-hike.
